bibl.title: Ptolemaic Queens as Ritualists and Recipients of Cults. The Cases of Arsinoe II and Berenike II.
bibl.seg: Martina Minas-Nerpel, Ptolemaic Queens as Ritualists and Recipients of Cults. The Cases of Arsinoe II and Berenike II.
bibl.note: 1. Intercultural demarcations and challenges of Ptolemaic queenship: 1.1 Macedonian influence; - 1.2. Ancient Egyptian influence. - 2. Arsinoe mrj(.t) b3 wḏ3(.t) b3; - 2.4. Arsinoe's distinctive crown; - 2.5. Arsinoe as ḥm.t-nṯr; - 2.6. Conclusion. - 3. Berenike II Euergetis: 3.1. Berenike II, the adopted daughter of Arsinoe II; - 3.2. The queen as "female Horus" and benefactress; - 3.3. The veneration of the dynastic ancestors. - 4. Conclusion.
